name: smart-qr-studio-backend
description: Smart QR Studio Dynamic QR API - Cloudflare Workers + D1. Deployed independently from the frontend.

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply smart-qr-studio-dev --local --env development
scripts.db:migrate:remote:development: wrangler d1 migrations apply smart-qr-studio-dev --env development
scripts.db:migrate:remote:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply smart-qr-studio-staging --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:remote:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply smart-qr-studio-prod --env production
